summary: Nucleus Phase 2/3 BATCH C + first half of BATCH D tested end-to-end on Expo web preview (mobile viewport 390x844). Backend skipped (unused stub). All 10 features in scope pass. Quick Tools (/tools): the 5 new chips Growth, Cooking, Time, Road trip, Decide render alongside the original 5; Growth shows the invested-vs-growth bar (growth-bar) and the future-value number updates when years change; Cooking exposes Volume / Cups→grams / Servings modes with tap-to-cycle units; Time 'Between' 09:30→18:15 correctly yields 08:45; Road trip 'Budget it' button appears and 'Per person' breakdown computes; Decide (random-roll-button) produces a result block each press. Dev Tools: OFF by default, enabled via module-toggle-dev in /modules; /dev then renders dev-header with all 11 chips; JSON pretty/minify shows dev-output for valid, dev-error for '{bad'; Base64 'hello'→'aGVsbG8='; URL 'a b&c'→'a%20b%26c'; JWT 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9…' shows algorithm HS256 + Expires fact; SHA256('abc') === ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad (exact match); UUID button generates 5 lines; Timestamp blank shows ISO (now), 1767225600 → 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z; Regex \d+ against 'abc 42 and 7' lists both matches; Diff shows + and − lines; Text and Colour (#1E90FF → RGB 30,144,255 + HSL 210°,100%,56% + swatch) all render. Copy button toasts 'Copied'. Custom Tool Builder (/builder): 'Paint needed' template preview shows '1 L' with no error, Save creates a tool and the chip tools-chip-custom-<id> appears in /tools; opening it computes from inputs. From-scratch tool with formula 'a * zzz' shows builder-unknown and disables Save (aria-disabled=true). Dangerous input 'process.exit(1)' and 'a[0]' are rejected with a readable builder-error (never crashes, parser safely refuses property access + unknown function call). Money Plan (/money/plan via money-plan-button): all 4 tabs reachable via plan-tabs. Month tab shows plan-too-early (today is pre-7th), plan-projected renders spent-so-far, 'Why this number?' opens the WhySheet with facts. Jars: target 20000 jar + 5000 contribution → ring shows 25% and 'put aside ~X a month' line appears. Debts: 300000/250000/9.5%/6000 debt → 'Clear in NN months' + interest line; editing payment to 100 switches the line to 'balance never clears'. Net worth: snapshot save works, worth-latest rendered (single-snapshot path verified; dual-snapshot delta line couldn't be exercised because DateField on web didn't accept playwright fill of a different date — minor test-tooling limitation, not a bug). Exports (settings-exports-button): sheet lists all 6 kinds (export-transactions/fuel/services/subscriptions/jars/notes/calendar) with real row counts (58 txns, 15 fuel, 5 services, 4 subs, 2 notes, 18 calendar events) and 'jars: 0 rows' row is aria-disabled; tapping Transactions triggers a real blob download 'nucleus-transactions-2026-10-02.csv' + toast 'Saved …'; Calendar downloads 'nucleus-calendar-2026-10-02.ics' similarly. Timeline (/timeline): grouped by month, 6 filter chips (Everything/Money/Vehicles/Travel/Home/Notes), filter-money gives 58 rows, rows navigate on tap. Review (/review): 5 swipeable review-card-* (On the road, Money, Looked after, Travelled, Kept on top of things); review-bars (12-month spending) rendered; year segmented control only appears when years.length > 1 (sample data only populates 2026 so it correctly hides — matches spec). Diagnostics (settings-diagnostics-button): sheet shows storage KB, record counts and scheduled reminder count. Accessibility (High contrast / Large touch targets / Reduce motion): all three Switches toggle and persist after full page reload (verified by reading aria-checked after reload); layout remained intact. Minor spec-nit: the exports success toast says 'Saved <filename>' (spec said 'toasts' — fine). No React Native deprecated-package or SafeAreaView issues observed in files reviewed. No regressions suspected in prior-iteration flows (settings, modules, lock gate, encrypted export page still mount cleanly).
action_items: Nothing blocking. Optional polish: the Export-sheet rows with 0 rows are marked aria-disabled but still receive the press ripple on mobile web (Press element lets the touch through visually before the handler no-ops). Harmless, but adding `disabled={e.count === 0}` on the Press itself would stop the ripple. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:445-472 (exports sheet rows).

Optional: Review screen's year Segmented control is only shown when years.length > 1. With pure sample data that gives one year, the control is hidden — this matches the spec ('year segmented control when more than one year of data exists') but worth confirming you want it hidden when exactly one year is present, since the spec word 'when more than one year of data exists' is satisfied either way.
critical_code_review_comments: src/core/formula.ts is a clean recursive-descent evaluator — no eval, no Function, no property access; only + - * / % ^, parentheses, numbers, variables, comma, and 10 whitelisted maths functions (min/max/round/floor/ceil/abs/sqrt/pow/log/exp). Dangerous inputs 'process.exit(1)' and 'a[0]' both throw ('Expected ")"' / 'Character not allowed: [') and are caught at the UI boundary — verified live.

app/money/plan.tsx cleanly separates projection/funds/debts/net-worth into one scrollable screen; Fund/Debt/Snapshot sheets reuse the same Sheet/Field/Button primitives; monthEndProjection returns {reliable, projected, spent, elapsed, over, budget, why} so the Why sheet gets structured facts.

app/dev/index.tsx uses expo-crypto.digestStringAsync for hashing and expo-crypto.randomUUID for UUIDs — correct, no deprecated APIs. JSON/JWT paths use fromB64/fromUtf8 helpers from core/crypto.ts; base64url normalisation (replace -/+ and _//) is handled.

app/builder/index.tsx shows a solid guard: Save is disabled when either `error` (parse error) or `unknown` names exist. Preview uses parseNum(i.value)||1 so empty fields still render a number instead of NaN. Dead inputs are kept via inputs.length > 1 guard on remove.

src/core/exports.ts single EXPORTS array drives the sheet, row counts and the download handler — easy to extend. On web, exportData presumably goes through a blob anchor (download attribute) — downloads worked in Playwright with expect_download, so the Content-Disposition / blob anchor is wired right.
No files exceed the 700-line soft cap: tools2 376, settings 524, plan 289, dev 256, builder 215. StyleSheet/useTheme used uniformly; no raw HTML elements in any screen checked.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 feature groups pass; the only reduced-scope spot is the net-worth dual-snapshot delta line which I couldn't exercise end-to-end because DateField on web doesn't accept a direct playwright fill — code-reviewed as correct, single-snapshot path and worth-latest testID both render).

seed_data_creation: Fresh browser each run — did onboarding + 'Explore with sample data' (vehicles Activa/Swift, 15 fuel entries, 5 services, 4 subscriptions, 58 transactions over 6 months, Goa trip with 18 calendar events, 3 appliances, 2 pinned notes, 2 rules). Then created one custom tool from the Paint-needed template to prove the chip-in-tools flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clean browser each playwright invocation — do localStorage.clear() + reload + 3× onboarding-next-button + onboarding-finish-sample-button for a known-good dataset. The Dev Tools module is OFF by default; use module-toggle-dev in /modules (not Settings) before hitting /dev or you'll be bounced by module-gate-dev. Dev output exposes testIDs dev-chip-{json|base64|url|jwt|hash|uuid|time|regex|diff|text|color}, dev-a-input / dev-b-input, dev-output, dev-output-value, dev-error, dev-copy-button, dev-color-swatch; hash uses its own dev-hash-input + dev-hash-button and the output lands in dev-output-value too. Exports kinds are 'transactions/fuel/services/subscriptions/jars/notes/calendar' (not 'txns'); 0-row rows set aria-disabled on the Press. On web a successful export emits a real blob download — use `async with page.expect_download():` to catch it; the Toast reads 'Saved <filename>'. The 'Why this number?' sheet on Money Plan projection uses the WhySheet component; close via the Sheet's [aria-label="Close"]. For DateField, direct `fill()` on the hidden input doesn't trigger — if you need two snapshots on different days, prefer calling setDate() through the UI's day/month pickers or set the date before saving the first snapshot.
rca_of_issue: No bugs raised in this iteration. Formula safety deserves a highlight: evaluateFormula lexes allowed characters (0-9 . A-Za-z _ + - * / % ^ ( ) ,) and rejects anything else with 'Character not allowed: X', so property access ('a[0]'), semicolons, and dot-chains are refused at the lexer stage; whitelisted functions are looked up in a frozen FUNCS table, and bare identifiers must appear in the user's input list, so 'process.exit(1)' is parsed as the unknown function `process` → `.` is a disallowed char → the UI shows builder-error. No crash, no runtime code — the parser is correctly sandboxed.
